Package io.github.sefiraat.slimetinker.utils

Class BlockDataCompat

java.lang.Object
io.github.sefiraat.slimetinker.utils.BlockDataCompat
public final class BlockDataCompat extends Object
Version-safe wrapper around the org.bukkit.block.data package (added in 1.13) and org.bukkit.Tag (added in 1.13). Every reference to those types is reflective so this class — and its callers — load cleanly on 1.8, where the APIs do not exist. On such legacy servers the operations degrade to no-ops or sensible defaults rather than throwing.
